name: Lunar Fungus
summary: Lunar Fungus grows in Darkshore's caves, where druids gather it for healing. Mixed with Earthroot and water, it helps make a salve for sick deer.

sections.title: Properties and Ecology
sections.body: Lunar Fungus grows from Lunar Fungal Blooms in Darkshore's underground caverns. The Cenarion Circle values its amplifying effects. Mixed with soothing water and common Earthroot, it lends potency to a salve that counters debilitating afflictions. Damp caves where it grows are also frequented by territorial moonkin, so gathering it means navigating carefully.

sections.title: A Lesson in Healing
sections.body: In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong has young druids gather Lunar Fungus as part of their studies in nature's healing arts. They see how physical ingredients such as this fungus can counter poisons in local deer. By learning how herbal remedies work, initiates prepare to channel natural antidotes through shapeshifting and spiritual power.

faq.q: What is Lunar Fungus used for?
faq.answer: Lunar Fungus adds curative potency to a restorative salve. Alanndarian Nightsong mixes it with Earthroot and clean water to treat sick deer in Darkshore.
Lunar Fungus grows from Lunar Fungal Blooms in caves east of Auberdine, in Darkshore. Irritable moonkin share these caverns and defend their territory from intruders.

faq.q: Who requires this fungus in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Alanndarian Nightsong asks students of the wild to gather Lunar Fungus as part of their training. The fungus is used to make remedies for ailing forest animals.

faq.q: Why do druid initiates have to gather physical herbs to cure poison?
faq.answer: Learning how physical antidotes work is a fundamental part of druidic education. Gathering reagents such as Lunar Fungus and seeing how ingredients counter toxins teaches students the principles of healing before they learn to purge poison through spiritual magic.

angles.text: As a young druid, you seek Lunar Fungus in Darkshore's caves as part of your early training in curative magic and healing poisoned wildlife.
As a night elf, you help tend the corrupted woodland creatures around Auberdine with native remedies such as Lunar Fungus.
